goal-01.description: Execute targeted hook and feature unit test verification across portal and shared feature modules.
goal-01.verification_criteria: All unit tests in portal and feature libraries pass with zero unhandled exceptions or leaks.

goal-02.description: Validate production build and bundle size limits for portal application.
goal-02.verification_criteria: pnpm nx build portal completes successfully with standalone dist output within bundle budgets.

goal-03.description: Run monorepo boundary, lint, and security compliance verification.
goal-03.verification_criteria: pnpm audit:compliance and pnpm policy:check pass cleanly.

goal-04.description: Verify local deployment container readiness and package standalone dist artifacts.
goal-04.verification_criteria: Local Docker stack healthcheck passes and portal dist image assets are validated.
